name: dcai
description: Use DCAI Desktop, dive shop software, from your AI: find customers and their next best sale, check boat trips and courses, and write emails and posts into DCAI for the shop to send.

interface.shortDescription: Work with your dive shop's DCAI
interface.longDescription: Find customers and their next best sale, check boat trips, courses, rentals and repairs, and write emails and social posts into DCAI's AI drafts inbox, where a person at the shop reviews and sends them. DCAI Desktop runs on the shop's own computer; the dcai skill needs DCAI open there with the dcai command turned on (Settings → Agents). Nothing goes out to a customer until a person presses Send.
defaultPrompt: Who's due for a refresher? Draft them a welcome-back email in DCAI.
Which boat trips this week still have seats? Draft a post for the emptiest one.
Look up Jordan in DCAI and tell me their next best sale.

prompts: Check that DCAI is reachable on this computer and list what you can do.
Find the customer named Jordan in DCAI and summarize their certifications and next best sale.
List this week's boat trips in DCAI with seats left.
Find certified divers not booked on the next boat trip and save a draft email to the first one in DCAI.
Save a draft Instagram post about Saturday's boat trip in DCAI's AI drafts.
Try DCAI while the app is closed and explain what the shop needs to do to continue.

publication.release_notes: First release: the dcai command, customers and next best sale, boat trips and courses, the day at the shop, and drafts for email and social posts.
